```{python}
#| label: fig-repeatability
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Repeatability versus reproducibility: (a) repeatability is the spread of a single measurement setup; (b) reproducibility is the difference between the mean values obtained by different operators, machines, or setups."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(-4, 4, 400)

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.2))

# (a) repeatability
ax = axs[0]
ax.plot(x, np.exp(-x**2 / 2), 'k-', lw=1.8)
ax.annotate('', xy=(-2.5, -0.13), xytext=(2.5, -0.13),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', lw=1.0))
ax.text(0, -0.25, 'repeatability', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('(a)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-4, 4); ax.set_ylim(-0.35, 1.2)
ax.axis('off')

# (b) reproducibility
ax = axs[1]
x2 = np.linspace(-8, 8, 600)
ax.plot(x2, np.exp(-(x2 + 3)**2 / 2), 'k-', lw=1.8)
ax.plot(x2, np.exp(-(x2 - 3)**2 / 2) * 1.15, 'k-', lw=1.8)
ax.text(-3, 1.1, 'operator A', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.text(3, 1.27, 'operator B', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.annotate('', xy=(-3, -0.13), xytext=(3, -0.13),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', lw=1.0))
ax.text(0, -0.25, 'reproducibility', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.plot([-3, -3], [0, 1.0], 'k:', lw=0.8)
ax.plot([3, 3], [0, 1.15], 'k:', lw=0.8)
ax.set_title('(b)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-8, 8); ax.set_ylim(-0.35, 1.45)
ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
